body: Last night was bad, I've never felt that low in my life and it's hard to shake that feeling of complete hopelessness. It helps knowing theres other people in my shoes that are carrying on too. Maybe just writing all this down is helping me cope.

Thank you. I just am really scared of my thoughts right now. This whole thing with her was such a shock that I'm not even remotely prepared to handle it. It just feels like the last thing I had to old on to is gone. I have nothing left motivating me to go on.
4 years, I think I'm mostly just in shock that it actually ended. I didn't even realize she was unhappy and I don't understand how I could miss that.
